22-EchoResponsive. Non-learned transfer of measured CRISPRi responses, no model training, no per-target exceptions, no official outcomes used. Identical to 20 in every respect except one gene-level amplitude law in the direction files, and the source-combination weights of 21 are not carried. The builder is byte for byte the file that built 20 and 21. Each gene gets a responsiveness score from the sources alone: how often it changes significantly across all knockdowns of three genome-wide screens. Within each band of control expression and each quartile of responsiveness, the predicted direction is scaled by how much of it the source lines themselves confirm when held out in turn. On highly expressed genes that rarely respond to any knockdown our prediction was measured as about ninety percent noise and is damped, and on responsive genes it is raised. Each target keeps the same total amplitude, so energy only moves between genes within a target, as the quiet band did in 20. Held out line by line, the law raises explained energy on all three lines and the ordering of the genes a Wilcoxon would call on all three. One amplitude scale per context is re-solved so the sampling budget equals the value 19, 20 and 21 spent. Identical to the published pseudocount-1e5 entry except for one added correction, so the pair is a clean A/B on it. dCas9-KRAB parked at a target promoter also silences whatever else is transcribed from that promoter, so a gene whose TSS sits within about a kilobase of the target's is knocked down alongside it; these pairs are almost always divergent. Measured on the 2025 H1 ground truth with GENCODE v47 TSS coordinates: 53 of 300 targets have such a neighbour, 67 percent of those neighbours fall below minus 0.2 log units against 1 percent of background genes, and the strongest reach minus 1.2 to minus 2.4 on well expressed genes. The implied remaining fraction f runs 0.17 within 500 bp and 0.53 from 500 to 1000 bp on Arc's platform, against 0.55 to 0.71 in the public reference lines, whose on-target knockdown is itself two to three times weaker; a reference averaged transfer therefore under predicts these genes badly. Each neighbour within 5 kb is floored at log1p(f times expm1(c)) minus c with f ramping from 0.15 to 1.0 in log distance, so the correction is expression aware and a gene the context does not transcribe cannot move. 75 pairs on this panel, 62 to 63 values changed per context.
